positive_changes_share_path_budget.qualification: Fixed timing-DAG perturbation screen only. Every path accumulates at most the sum of positive/negative changed timing edges; any path containing a positive change has the recorded current setup gap, and any path containing a negative change has the recorded current hold slack. Distinct atom-driver/receiver combinations conservatively bound repeated cluster-connection contributions. Unknown mappings/constraints abstain. Zero RC, unchanged packed/placed/clock/logic mapping and exact declared connection changes are prerequisites. Endpoint vectors may trade setup slack. Native route legality, actual native arithmetic/STA and original envelopes remain independent mandatory gates; no tolerance or predicted quality substitutes for them.
